literal: If wealth reaches with the one who has benevolence, it is indeed like a fruit tree having ripened inside the village.
translation: When wealth comes to a benevolent person who loves to help others, it is like a fruitful tree ripening in the very center of a village.
modern: பிறருக்கு உதவும் நற்பண்பு உடையவனிடம் செல்வம் சேருவது, ஊரின் நடுவே உள்ள பயன் தரும் மரம் பழுத்திருப்பதைப் போன்றது ஆகும்.
explanation: The couplet compares the wealth of a benevolent person to a fruit-bearing tree in the middle of a village. A fruit tree located inside a village is accessible to everyone, and its fruits can be enjoyed by all without any hindrance. Similarly, when wealth reaches a person who has the quality of benevolence (நயன்), it is not hoarded but is naturally shared to benefit the entire community. The key words 'பயன்மரம்' (fruitful tree) and 'நயனுடையான்' (benevolent person) highlight how true wealth finds its purpose only when it is accessible and useful to others.
